commands.review_summary:
Adds gateway terminal detach/reattach with bounded replay buffers, terminal.attach/list/text protocol methods, a detached-session timeout config key, docs/Swift/schema updates, and Control UI session reattach after reload or reconnect.

PR surface: Source +731, Tests +442, Docs +5, Other +128. Total +1306 across 66 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review blockers at source level: attachSession closes an already-existing session after disposeAllTabs cancellation, and the schema accepts timeout values that Node schedules as 1 ms after overflow. I did not run the full browser flow in this read-only review.

target.title: feat(gateway): terminal detach/reattach with output replay, terminal.list, terminal.text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Operator terminal sessions die the instant their gateway connection drops (`TerminalSessionManager.closeForConn()` kills every owned PTY tree on WS close). Close the laptop, reload the Control UI, or hit a network blip and the shell — plus any long-running command in it — is gone. Fixes #100085.

## Why This Change Was Made

VibeTunnel/tmux-style decoupling of PTY lifetime from the viewer connection is the standard fix, and it maps additively onto the existing `terminal.*` surface:

- **Bounded per-session output ring** (constant 256 KiB, `src/gateway/terminal/session-manager.ts`) buffers recent output for replay and `terminal.text`. Raw byte replay, not a true VT screen snapshot — a real snapshot needs a server-side terminal emulator per session (heavier dep + CPU); noted in code as a follow-up. Emulators recover on the next full repaint (prompt, clear, resize-triggered redraw), and the UI resizes right after attach, which also delivers the SIGWINCH repaint.
- **Detach instead of kill on disconnect**: sessions park ownerless with a reaper; killed after `gateway.terminal.detachedSessionTimeoutSeconds` (new config key, default 300, `0` = previous kill-on-disconnect). Detached sessions are capped (8, oldest evicted); everything is still hard-killed on gateway shutdown. `gateway.terminal.*` changes keep the existing restart-reload rule, so the value is read at construction.
- **`terminal.attach {sessionId}`** rebinds a live-or-detached session to the calling admin connection and returns `{…, buffer}`. Attach is tmux-style take-over: the terminal surface is already `operator.admin` (full host access), so cross-connection attach adds no privilege; a previous live owner gets `terminal.exit` with new reason `detached`. Snapshot + rebind are one synchronous step, so no byte can appear in both the replay buffer and the live stream.
- **`terminal.list`** exposes attachable sessions (`sessionId, agentId, shell, cwd, confined, attached, createdAtMs`) for reconnect discovery.
- **`terminal.text {sessionId}`** returns the buffer as plain text (ANSI stripped, CR overwrites collapsed — `src/gateway/terminal/buffer-text.ts`) without attaching; an agent/LLM affordance.
- **Web UI reattach** (`ui/src/ui/terminal/terminal-panel.ts`): live session ids persist per browser tab and the panel reattaches them on reload/reconnect, replaying the buffer into ghostty. Deliberately `sessionStorage`, not `localStorage`: attach is take-over, and a shared per-origin key would make multiple Control UI windows clobber one id list and steal each other's live shells; per-tab storage covers exactly the reattach cases (reload, laptop sleep, transient disconnect). A disconnect also no longer overwrites the persisted "panel open" preference, so reconnect auto-reopens and reattaches.

Protocol changes are additive: new methods appended at the end of the descriptor table (advertised indices stay stable), new exit reason appended to the union, JSON schema + Swift models regenerated. A new regression test pins the descriptor-table/lazy-handler-table parity that the first cut of this branch got wrong (`terminal.attach` advertised but dispatching as `unknown method`).

Follow-ups deliberately out of scope: true server-side VT snapshot, multi-viewer shared sessions (Crabfleet-style terminal multiplayer), persistence across gateway restarts, recording to disk, mobile WebView reattach (needs an explicit `?attach=<id>` seam since WebView sessionStorage does not survive recreation).

## User Impact

Terminal sessions survive page reloads, laptop sleep, and transient disconnects; the Control UI reconnects to the same shell with recent output replayed and the session still live. Agents/tools can read a session's output via `terminal.text` without attaching. Operators who want the old fail-closed behavior set `gateway.terminal.detachedSessionTimeoutSeconds: 0`. Docs updated (`docs/web/control-ui.md`, `docs/gateway/configuration-reference.md`).

## Evidence

- Unit (vitest, colocated): ring bounds + oversized-chunk tail; detach → reap timing with fake timers; attach rebind, buffer replay, and stream resumption; live take-over notify; unknown/expired attach; re-detach with fresh grace on second disconnect; detached-session cap eviction; list ordering/attached flags; shutdown hard-kills detached sessions with zero timers left; handler kill-switch gating for attach/list/text; plain-text rendering; client-side attach replay ordering (buffer → raced events → live) and failure-path listener cleanup. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/terminal/ src/gateway/server-methods/terminal.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods-list.test.ts` and `ui/src/ui/terminal/` — all green.
- **Live E2E against a real dist gateway** (throwaway `HOME`, port 19877, headless Chromium/playwright): opened the terminal, ran `i=0; while true; do i=$((i+1)); echo TICK_$i; sleep 1; done`, reloaded the page, and the panel reattached the **same session id** (`c4f9af89-…` before and after), with TICK_1–3 replayed from the buffer and TICK_4–7 streaming live after reattach; then typed `echo AFTER_RELOAD_PROOF_$((6*7))` into the reattached shell and `terminal.text` returned plain text containing the full sequence and `AFTER_RELOAD_PROOF_42`. `terminal.list` over `openclaw gateway call` showed the session `attached:false` after the browser closed, and it was reaped (empty list) after the 300 s grace — reaper live-verified.
- Typecheck: tsgo core, core-test, ui-test lanes clean. Lint: directory scan `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src ui packages` clean. `pnpm build` clean (no `INEFFECTIVE_DYNAMIC_IMPORT`). Full UI vitest project: only known load-flaky full-app timeouts that pass in isolation and differ run-to-run.
- Autoreview (Codex/gpt-5.5): one finding — "teardown close RPCs could kill reattachable sessions" — rejected with proof: the browser client hard-rejects RPCs when the socket is not OPEN (`ui/src/ui/gateway.ts` `request()`), the server enforces connection ownership on `terminal.close`, and the live E2E shows reload preserving the session; invariant now documented at the call site.
